state.task: Finish this bounded code review. Preserve supported distinct defects and accurately scope their impact. Do not claim whole-repository completeness.
contracts: AWS provider IDs must start with aws:///.
A placeholder instance name beginning with i-placeholder- must retain subsequent slashes.

findings.message: The placeholder alternative lacks a start anchor, so malformed IDs such as junkaws:///us-east-1a/i-placeholder-some pass validation. Previously both alternatives required aws:/// at the beginning, as required by the note's invalid-format boundary.
findings.evidence:
New regex: `^aws\:\/\/\/[-0-9a-z]*\/[-0-9a-z]*(\/[-0-9a-z\.]*)?$|aws\:\/\/\/[-0-9a-z]*\/%s.*$`
Previous placeholder alternative: `^aws\:\/\/\/[-0-9a-z]*\/(%s.*)$`
Validation rejects only when validAwsRefIdRegex.FindStringSubmatch(id) == nil.

findings.message: Placeholder names containing slashes are truncated. For aws:///us-east-1a/i-placeholder-some/arbitrary/cluster/local, Name becomes i-placeholder-some instead of the complete placeholder name, violating the note's preservation requirement.
findings.evidence:
splitted := strings.Split(id[7:], "/")
Name:       splitted[1],
Deleted test expected Name: "i-placeholder-some/arbitrary/cluster/local".

claim_support.instructions: Assess all current findings against source actually supplied. Are their causal and impact claims supported? A correct local observation does not by itself establish a broader operational consequence. A contract is an expectation, not evidence that a downstream path was inspected.

criteria.supported: All stated claims are supported by supplied source/evidence or explicitly qualified.
criteria.overclaimed: At least one asserted consequence goes beyond the inspected evidence; retain supported local claims but qualify or investigate the broader claim.
criteria.contradicted: Supplied evidence contradicts at least one reported defect.
criteria.insufficient: Cannot determine support from supplied evidence.

coverage.instructions: Within the supplied changed source and explicit contracts, do the findings account for the apparent distinct defects? This is not a claim about uninspected code. Check every finding, including secondary findings flattened into the list.

criteria.accounted_for: Apparent contract violations in the supplied changed source are represented in current findings; no specific uncovered path is apparent.
criteria.gap: A specific distinct potentially defective changed behavior remains unaddressed by current findings.
criteria.unknown: Evidence is too limited to assess coverage even for this bounded scope.

next_action.instructions: Choose the most useful next action to finish this bounded review. Preserve distinct supported findings.
